verdict.rationale: Gitea's site explicitly advertises integrations with external CI/CD tools such as Drone, Woodpecker, Argo CD and Jenkins, plus an API and webhooks for custom workflows. Community users report running Gitea + Drone stably for years, including after migrating off GitLab's bundled CI. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup documentation for specific external CI integrations (e.g. webhook/OAuth configuration, commit-status reporting back to PRs), and hands-on corroboration beyond Drone (e.g. Jenkins, Argo CD).
